published_figures.figure: Type certificate data sheet 3A13, section XIII, propeller limits: "Static RPM at full throttle: Not over 2400; Not Under 2300". The governor holds 2,400 and hunts a fraction of an rpm about it; 5 rpm above is allowed for that.

Page ii, performance specifications: take-off ground roll 795 ft at sea level, standard day, 3,100 lb; figure 5-6 gives the technique - flaps 20, 2,400 rpm and full throttle before brake release, paved level dry runway, zero wind - and lift-off at 49 KIAS, which figure 5-1 makes 57.5 KCAS with 20 degrees of flap.

Page ii: "Cruise, 80% Power at 6000 Ft (Best Power Mixture) 140 KTS", 3,100 lb, standard day. Figure 5-9 gives 23 inches and 2,400 rpm at 6,000 ft as 76% at the recommended lean mixture, which is peak EGT (page 5-6); best power is 125 F richer, and flown here leaned for best power it is the model's 80%.
Page ii: maximum speed at sea level 145 KTS, full throttle and 2,400 rpm, with the speed fairings.

Figure 3-1, maximum glide: 75 KIAS at 3,100 lb, propeller windmilling, flaps up, zero wind, drawn as about 20.5 nautical miles from 14,000 ft above the terrain - 8.9 to 1, read from the chart; the tolerance allows for that. 75 KIAS is 77.5 KCAS by figure 5-1.
Figure 5-4, stall speeds, 3,100 lb, power off, wings level, flaps up: 54 KCAS at the most rearward centre of gravity and 56 at the most forward. The range is 2 kt either side of those.
Figure 5-4, flaps 20 degrees: 50 KCAS rearward and 52 forward, 2 kt either side.
Figure 5-4, flaps FULL (38 degrees): 49 KCAS rearward and 50 forward, 2 kt either side.
